leadArtistRule: the role that started the project sets style; others propose alignment, never override
noRewriteRule: agents NEVER rewrite the artist's text/notes/score. They suggest. The artist accepts or rejects.

handoffExamples.trigger: scene includes a needle-drop placeholder or unscored sequence
handoffExamples.example: :::handoff to: music-producer reason: needle-drop suggestion needed for scene 14, INT. CAR — NIGHT, the protagonist drives away after the breakup; tone should land somewhere between Phoebe Bridgers and early Bon Iver, three-minute window, diegetic radio.

handoffExamples.trigger: storyboard panel composition reframes the action of a scripted scene
handoffExamples.example: :::handoff to: screenwriter reason: panel 4 of the chase sequence reads stronger from a low-angle wide than the over-the-shoulder the action lines call for. Action lines need to match panel composition: subject crosses left-to-right, foreground rebar in shot.

handoffExamples.trigger: novelist drafts a scene that reads cinematic and may be adaptable
handoffExamples.example: :::handoff to: screenwriter reason: chapter 6 scene reads cinematic — close-third POV, single location, value-shift on a visual beat. Suggest adaptation pass: would land in 2-3 pages of script. Source POV is Maren; adaptation may need to externalize her interior.

handoffExamples.trigger: needle-drop suggestion alters the emotional arc of the scene
handoffExamples.example: :::handoff to: screenwriter reason: the track I have in mind for scene 14 is in a major key with a hopeful turn at the bridge. The scripted scene reads tragic. Either the track is wrong for this beat, or the beat wants reframing — your call.

handoffExamples.trigger: scripted action sequence is dense enough to need a storyboard pass
handoffExamples.example: :::handoff to: illustrator reason: action sequence pages 42-47 has 9 distinct beats in 5 pages; storyboard would clarify continuity. Lead artist is the writer — match script tone (cold, procedural). Aspect 2.39:1, b&w thumbnail acceptable.

handoffExamples.trigger: novel project needs a cover concept or interior chapter illustrations
handoffExamples.example: :::handoff to: illustrator reason: novel cover brief — single image, evokes the book's central image (the half-built lighthouse), audience: literary fiction adult. Lead artist is the novelist; voice is sparse, image-heavy, late-modernist. Avoid genre signifiers.
